feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 November 2026 9:35pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 13 November 2026 at 9:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

High pressure of England and Northern France, extending a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, gradually increasing south or southwest 5 or 6 tomorrow morning. Perhaps touching 7 in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight becoming moderate or rough tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6 occasionally 7 at first. Decreasing 4 or 5 Sunday morning, then veering northwest towards midday and increasing 6 or 7, occasionally gale 8 later on Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, decreasing mainly moderate for a time Sunday morning.


##Weather##

Occasional rain arriving from the west overnight into Sunday..


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later.
